warnings: Tesla T4 is compute capability 7.5: no bfloat16 support. Set engine.dtype=float16 explicitly - leaving it on 'auto' will make vLLM refuse to load a bf16 checkpoint.
notes: Compute capability 7.5 is below 8.0, so vLLM's FlashAttention-2 backend is unavailable. Measured on vLLM 0.29 / T4: it selects TRITON_ATTN (candidates were TRITON_ATTN and FLEX_ATTENTION). Record which attention backend was active alongside every benchmark result - results are not comparable across backends.
No native FP8 tensor cores. Phase 6 quantisation should target AWQ or GPTQ int4 rather than FP8.
Marlin int4 kernels need compute capability 8.0+. AWQ/GPTQ still run here, on the slower generic kernels - factor that into any quantisation speedup claim.
2 GPUs visible: tensor_parallel_size up to 2 is testable in Phase 6.
15 GB of VRAM. A ~1.5B model in float16 leaves plenty of room for KV cache, which is what actually stresses continuous batching. Prefer a small model with a large batch over a large model.
